name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) — Micro-Irrigation
benefit_summary: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems — typically 55% for small/marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers (rates vary by state top-up)
required_documents: Water source proof (bore well / canal / farm pond)
notes: VERIFY against your own pmksy_micro_irrigation.txt — subsidy percentages vary by farmer category (general / SC-ST / small-marginal) and by state top-up schemes; confirm current rates on MahaDBT for Maharashtra.
